composition_dependency_resolution.finding: No admitted block exists for any named host scope; all composition tiers remain non-executable.
Lane 01 defines composition.capability_intersection but does not publish the action_contract.capabilities enum required by the solver.
Lane 01 proposes registry.admission_scope; lane 05 asks for admitted_for_host_scope. Semantic equivalence is plausible but not contracted.
Lane 01 uses rights_state in lifecycle events and rights_composition rules but does not publish a canonical license_state enum.
Lane 04 publishes a valid receipt schema with all 14 v1 types/fields preserved, 18 total receipt types, and 8 payload definitions. It remains a proposal, not an adopted contract.
Lane 03 publishes ten archetype identifiers, a 20-required-field template contract, and 34 industry-archetype pairs.
Lane 02 verifies the local inventory and 8,515-component union, but provenance/license coverage is 2/11,549 and current marketplace terms gate reuse.
No canonical Actionist host/auth/data/deploy contract exists.
Model, sandbox, build, scan, benchmark, and execution authorization was not granted.

receipt_family_join.note: Shape choice precedes interface proof and must not substitute for it.

demand_supply_join.decision: Build/adapt case_workflow and portal deliberately; do not infer that abundant generic CRM/admin boilerplates satisfy the highest-value demand.

local_supply_join.decision: Treat both stores as research/reference inputs and preserve them as complementary. No block candidate is rights-cleared by corpus membership.

repo_to_block_join.decision: The foundry can automate identity, closure computation, schema validation and portions of proof; shape choice, semantic adaptation and admission require named accountable humans.

composition_join.solver: deterministic model-free compatibility elimination before model choice

contradictions.statement: Large corpus breadth versus reusable supply
contradictions.resolution: 8,515 joined components is discovery breadth; 2/11,549 license-field coverage and current terms prevent reuse admission.
Only 270 industry-repository pairs cover all ten dimensions. Cell breadth is not pair completeness.

contradictions.statement: Universal composition design versus zero admitted blocks
contradictions.resolution: Architecture and model-free tiers can be specified, but no end-to-end composition run is currently possible.

contradictions.statement: Automated repo conversion versus semantic responsibility
contradictions.resolution: Lane 04 classifies eight mechanisms DET, four DET-ENV and six SEMI; stages 2, 6 and 10 retain human authority.
Commodity CRM/admin starters dominate supply while case_workflow and portal dominate demand and remain thin.

contradictions.statement: Contract v2 proposal versus v1 identity regex
contradictions.resolution: No v2 identifier can validate until X-1 is fixed; the delta is research-only and not applied.

contradictions.statement: Intact AGPL donor operation versus reference-only harvest policy
contradictions.resolution: Packaging mode can distinguish intact service/fork from extracted reuse, but legal confirmation is still absent.

contradictions.statement: Local pipeline maturity versus client readiness
contradictions.resolution: Block, template, mechanics and composition contracts exist only as designs; runtime, security, economics, client/legal and admission receipts remain unexecuted.

verified_phase_result: Phase-8 five-lane research contract is complete and independently verified. Product implementation, contract adoption, execution, block admission, original 100M-token objective, exhaustive competitor/features work, and 1,700 complete-pair objective remain incomplete.
